question.text: A PM's portfolio construction approach that combines Value and Momentum factors is an example of:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook supports factor-based construction using either a single factor or multiple factors, and lists value and momentum among the smart-beta and factor inputs. Combining Value and Momentum is therefore multi-factor investing. The Trap: Single-factor investing tilts to one factor only and does not blend across factors such as value and momentum. Note: Per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.311, p.313, and p.315).
